settings:
# Exploratory follow-up of 12.11.2026 (course folder pro/followup-2026-11-12/plan.md), chosen after the main
# results and two reviews. Not in the plan; decides no hypothesis. Bars and predictions below were
# written before the run. "Reduction" is the relative error reduction of the main report.
#
# N3, selection or representation. Synthetic data built in memory (src/dfx/datasets.py): 1,000 rows, 10
# N(0,1) features, 3 seeds. Targets: additive (add); an exact product x1*x2 (prod); an interaction
# sign(x1)*x2^2 with which the product x1*x2 is uncorrelated (hidden). "_oracle" holds the true
# interaction term as an extra input and "_oracle_noise" holds it with 10 noise columns; for these two the
# base cascade is the method of interest (the others run too, for completeness). Folds are the same for
# all variants of a target. 7 x 9 x 3 x 5 = 945 tasks.
# Expected: add: nothing helps. prod: the chosen products do about as well as the oracle. hidden: the
# chosen products do not help while the oracle does (selection misses it). The oracle with noise columns
# shows how much of the oracle's gain the extra columns take back.
datasets = ["syn_add", "syn_prod", "syn_hidden", "syn_add_oracle", "syn_prod_oracle", "syn_hidden_oracle",
            "syn_add_oracle_noise", "syn_prod_oracle_noise", "syn_hidden_oracle_noise"]
seeds = [0, 1, 2]
outer_folds = 5

[[check]]
name = "default"
methods = ["base", "random_xx", "target_xx", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx", "rf", "lightgbm"]
